规则来源；不是 benchmark 论文。当前 local SQL 仅给出字段与: A rule source, not a benchmark paper. Current local SQL specifies fields and rules; individual animal-model papers, DOIs, supplements, and data snapshots are still missing. This is a design-stage query, not one supplied by the paper.
共10职位是参数实例，此处逐条展示当前SQL明确指定的29243；仅正向qrel: The ten jobs are parameter instances; this view uses job 29243 explicitly specified by the current SQL. Only positive qrels are available; unjudged items are not negatives.
岗位与简历文本由真实结构化资料合成并人工核查；论文提供匹配任务，当前过滤 pla: Job and resume texts are synthesized from real structured records and manually checked. The paper provides the matching task; this filter plan is locally derived. File-level verification of 29243 against the release package remains incomplete.
本仓Q1逻辑SQL；不把所有笛卡尔积对当作有gold。: Local Q1 logical SQL; not all Cartesian-product pairs are assumed to have gold labels.
TREC 2021 proceedings, published 2022；总览: TREC 2021 proceedings, published 2022; general overview, not a dedicated track paper
源任务为给定患者检索试验；逐对判断、反向患者清单与标签计数由本项目派生。qrel: The source task retrieves trials for a given patient. Pairwise judgments, reverse patient lists, and label counts are derived here. qrels: 0 not relevant, 1 excluded, 2 eligible; these are not actual clinical enrollment outcomes.
这里展示从原输入端到端展开；只读Q1预测物化表时Q2本身是纯SQL。: This view expands the plan end to end from original inputs. Q2 alone is pure SQL when reading the materialized Q1 predictions.
